name: application-quantity-inputs
title: Quantity Inputs
description: Stepper controls for incrementing and decrementing a numeric quantity, designed for cart, order, and inventory contexts.
useWhen: Users need to select a numeric quantity such as item count in a shopping cart or order form.
A number field benefits from explicit increment and decrement buttons for touch usability.
The value range is small and discrete, such as 1–99 for an order quantity.
avoidWhen: The range is very wide (e.g., 0–10,000) — a plain number input or slider is better suited.
Precision decimal values are required — the stepper pattern is designed for integers.
The quantity is not user-editable — display the value as text instead.
responsiveBehavior: Stepper controls remain their natural size. Ensure plus and minus buttons meet the 44×44px minimum tap target size on touch devices.
accessibility: The number input must have a linked label; plus and minus buttons need descriptive aria-labels.
Announce the current value to screen readers when it changes via aria-live or by keeping focus on the input.
Disable the minus button when the minimum value is reached; disable plus at the maximum.

variants.title: Base with plus and minus buttons
variants.description: Bordered number input flanked by separate minus and plus buttons with native browser spin controls visible.
accessibility: Input needs a linked label; plus/minus buttons need aria-labels; announce value changes.

variants.title: Base with plus and minus buttons (Dark)
variants.description: Plus/minus bordered stepper with native spin controls adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Dark input border and button colors must meet WCAG AA contrast requirements.

variants.title: Base with plus and minus buttons, no spinners in the input
variants.description: Stepper with the native browser number-input spin arrows hidden for a cleaner visual style.
accessibility: Without native spinners, plus/minus buttons are the sole increment path and must be keyboard-accessible.

variants.title: Base with plus and minus buttons, no spinners (Dark)
variants.description: Clean stepper with hidden native spin arrows adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Button and input colors must maintain contrast; native spinners remain hidden.

variants.title: Base with plus and minus buttons, no spinners and text centered
variants.description: Stepper with hidden spin arrows and the value text centered in the input for a symmetrical appearance.
accessibility: Centered text is decorative; functional requirements are the same as the no-spinner variant.

variants.title: Base with plus and minus buttons, no spinners and text centered (Dark)
variants.description: Centered-value stepper with hidden spin arrows adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Centered input text and button colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.

variants.title: Bordered with plus and minus buttons
variants.description: Pill-bordered stepper where the minus button, input, and plus button share a single continuous border.
accessibility: Shared border is decorative; each button still needs its own aria-label and focus ring.

variants.title: Bordered with plus and minus buttons (Dark)
variants.description: Pill-bordered continuous stepper adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Continuous border, input text, and button icons must meet contrast on dark backgrounds.
